How ordering works

Five steps, no surprises

1

Choose & send your request

Pick a cap, design or towel — and your size — from the shop below, and send us your request with your email. You do not need to attach a file here.

2

Get your quote

We estimate the total cost, including shipping, and send you a quote by email.

3

Accept, pay & reply in the same thread

If you accept, reply to our email with your order request. After you pay the quoted total, simply reply to that same email thread with your receipt, your PO number and your payment details. You can attach your design or logo file when you reply to our email.

4

We confirm your delivery dates

Once your order is received, we take 1–2 days to discuss it with our design and production team, and confirm your delivery date range.

5

Receive

Made for you, checked by hand, and delivered to your door — usually in 3–4 weeks. We email you when it is on its way.

How it works

  1. We estimate the total cost, including shipping, and send you a quote.
  2. If you accept, reply to our email with your order request. After payment, reply to that same email thread with your receipt, your PO number (which we sent you by email after your order) and your payment details — that is all you need to do.
  3. Once your order is received, we take 1–2 days to discuss it with our design and production team, and confirm your delivery date range.

Fit & care

The right fit in 20 seconds

Standard fit

Short hair / racing

Snug and streamlined — the racing choice. Measure around the head, just above the ears, if you are between sizes.

Long-hair fit

Long or thick hair

A roomier fit, so hair tucks in comfortably without pulling at the forehead.

Extra-room fit

Braids, twists, big hair

The most room we offer. Tell us in your request and we confirm the best size with your quote.

Care: rinse in clean water after each swim, dry inside-out away from direct sun, and keep clear of sharp nails and jewellery when putting your cap on — your print will last much longer.

Shipping & payment

What you pay, and when

Product prices never include shipping. Your quote always shows both, as one total, before you pay.

Shipping — by zone & weight

Guide rates for a small parcel with one cap, including packaging:

DestinationOne cap
United KingdomUS$17
Germany & EuropeUS$23
United StatesUS$25
Hong KongHK$65

Bundles, towels and team orders travel as one parcel and are weighed together — the exact shipping charge for your order is confirmed in your quote, before you pay. Other destinations: quoted the same way.

Payment — Wise, after approval

1. Approve your design preview and the total in your quote.

2. Our Wise payment details arrive with your confirmed quote, so you pay the approved total to the right account, in USD.

3. After you pay, simply reply to the same email thread — the thread with your quote and PO number — and attach your receipt, with your PO number and your payment details (Wise transaction / payment record number, amount paid). We check our account by hand and confirm receipt in that same thread before your order is made.

Your confirmation email is your receipt: it carries your PO number, matched to the amount you paid and your transaction reference, plus your product, delivery details and estimated delivery date.

New to swimming?

Start with the fit, not the speed: a comfortable cap that stays on makes lessons easier for children and coaches alike. Our four step-by-step SwimSteps lessons — water confidence, calm breathing, floating & kicking, and first strokes — pair each stage with the gear it needs. Ask in your request and we will point you to the right lesson and cap for your child's stage.

FAQ

Questions, answered briefly

How long will my order take?

Usual delivery is 3–4 weeks, door to door. Once your order is received, we take 1–2 days to discuss it with our design and production team, and confirm your delivery date range. If you need it urgently, let us know and we can quote our premium delivery service — all standard shipping quotes are based on normal delivery.

Can I get my order faster?

Yes — if you need your order urgently, please let us know and ask about our premium delivery service. All standard shipping quotes are based on normal delivery, which usually takes 3–4 weeks, door to door.

How much is shipping?

It depends on your destination zone and the weight of your parcel. Guide rates for one cap are in the shipping section above; your exact charge is confirmed in your quote as part of one total — product + shipping.

When do I pay, and how?

Only after you approve your design preview and quote. You pay the quoted total by Wise in USD — our Wise details arrive with your confirmed quote. After you pay, simply reply to that same email thread with your receipt, your PO number and your payment details.

How do I send my receipt after payment?

After payment, reply to our email with your receipt and PO number.

What do you need for a name or logo print?

For a name, the exact spelling in your request. For a logo, a clear file (PNG, PDF or vector is best) — just attach it when you reply to our email. We print up to 5 colours, and you always approve a visual proof first. Please double-check spelling: we print exactly what you approve.

Can I mix designs in a bundle?

Ask in your request — for most combinations we can confirm a mixed bundle in your quote, at the same bundle pricing for that cap style.

Can I return a customised item?

Personalised items are made for you, so they can't be returned for a change of mind. If anything arrives faulty, or different from the preview you approved, tell us and we will put it right with a replacement.
